# Scenario

One warning in a `warning: false` chunk. Its message holds a newline. The
function prints before and after the warning, so a capture of the warning
would split the printed output into two blocks.

```{r}
#| label: warning-false
#| warning: false
f <- function() {
  print("before")
  warning("fixture warning-false\nsecond line")
  print("after")
}
f()
```
